prompts.customer_initial:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: actual design reference image for a future reservation web UI, target S4 concept, high-fidelity responsive comparison board.
Primary request: Create ONE polished landscape design board with an existing Japanese salon booking web app shown at 1440px desktop and 320px phone width. This is a restrained extension to a real existing design, not a redesign.
Composition: At the top place the exact caption "Target S4 concept". Main area: a large desktop booking screen on the left and a tall 320px mobile rendering of the SAME booking screen on the right. Beneath them, small distinct inset panels for the details/review summary and the remembered-booking page; do not merge separate pages into one user flow.
Design language: centered 1180px shell, open airy intro, narrow English eyebrow, Japanese headings, white-ish bordered cards with 0.75rem rounded corners, tiny restrained shadow, native-looking form select/input/date controls and pill time slots at least 44px tall, no horizontal overflow on the phone. Japanese system font feeling: Hiragino Sans / Yu Gothic UI / BIZ UDPGothic.
Palette EXACT: canvas #edf3f1, card #fbfdfc, primary text #102c2d, teal accent #0f6267, strong accent #08484d, border #b9cdca, focus ring #005fcc. No added brand color.
Content, short Japanese labels rendered verbatim when practical: small abstract square mark "日"; page title "予約の申請"; steps "1 日時を選ぶ", "2 連絡先を入力", "3 確認して送信"; the ONLY new top field in booking selection "場所を選ぶ" native select showing "サロン B", above the existing "サービス" field. Follow with "カット", "相談", "日付", "担当・設備", "開始時間". Details/review inset includes summary row "場所  サロン B  変更". Remembered-booking inset is a separate screen with card "予約001", "サロン A", "確認中", and a small separate neutral retry/error card "確認できませんでした" "再読み込み".
Make the location distinction visually unmistakable: a customer's current choice is サロン B, while a saved proof card can belong to サロン A. Render loading/empty state as a small inline message under availability, not a fullscreen failure.
Constraints: Only fictional neutral "サロン A", "サロン B", "予約001" and generic service labels. No actual customer, addresses, contact information, keys, secrets, real business identity, logos, provider brands, sign-in on customer UI, map, photographs, imports, production data, or four-store grid. Do not imply this is delivered software. Preserve existing simple cards and three-step booking journey. Aim for readable hierarchy and genuine high-fidelity application UI, not decorative concept art.
prompts.operator_initial:

Composition: Exact caption "Target S4 concept" above all frames. Top row: wide desktop operator board and narrow tall phone operator board. Bottom row: wide desktop owner settings crop and narrow phone owner settings crop. Keep these as clearly separate app screens, not mixed on one page. Each frame should feel like an actual usable application screenshot with correct density.
Design language: centered max 1180px shell; English eyebrow "OPERATOR BOARD" or "INSTALLATION SETUP"; Japanese heading; white-ish bordered cards with 0.75rem rounded corners, muted gray-green surface, restrained badges, native-looking selects/checkboxes and controls at least 44px high, strong visible blue keyboard focus; no horizontal scroll. 1440px operator view has an attention aside and main day/week schedule board; mobile stacks toolbar, attention and board in a single column. Settings uses the existing form panels and two-column fields on desktop, stacked fields on mobile. Japanese system font feeling: Hiragino Sans / Yu Gothic UI / BIZ UDPGothic.
Palette EXACT: canvas #edf3f1, card #fbfdfc, primary text #102c2d, teal accent #0f6267, strong accent #08484d, border #b9cdca, focus ring #005fcc. No extra color system.
Content, short Japanese labels verbatim when practical. Operator toolbar FIRST field "表示中の場所" native select "サロン A"; after it "開始日", tabs "1日" and "7日"; a small inline status "読み込み中"; attention card "確認待ち"; schedule cards "予約と休業時間"; ordinary detail and proxy booking/closure actions. Clear target-concept caption; do not imply delivered functionality. Preserve current native panels, information density, and responsive layout.
